correctness.rationale: Normalize to [0,1]. At the midpoint z=(x+y)/2, quadraticity gives W(x)-W(y)=DW(z)(x-y) exactly. The derivative kills constants, so it suffices to test unit step directions. For a step with k right samples in a window the derivative is 2h_k/m², where h_k=(m-k)ΣR_r-kΣL_s. The full packet has h_0=h_m=0. After collapsing repeated endpoint zeros an edge-truncated packet is a consecutive part of the full packet (the text's literal subsequence language omits those repetitions, which do not affect variation). In the sign dual of its variation, the contribution of a pair of sign indices i<j is (R_i-L_{m-j+1})(σ_i-σ_j). For each fixed sign vector, the maximum over all samples is twice the number of opposite-sign pairs: every positive right coefficient can be saturated at one and every positive left coefficient at one, independently. Thus the maximum is 2 floor(m²/4). The balanced-block baseline has h_k=(m-k)min(k,floor(m/2)), rises then falls, and attains that packet variation at n=2m. Interior symmetric secants approach its derivative; appending zeros maintains the full packet. Rescaling restores b-a. The short-length statement is an upper bound only, and sharpness at longer lengths is a supremum. Inspected the proof, VERIFICATION.md and verify_variance.py without executing the script.
